answer: Require every agent to earn a fresh work passport each epoch: to gain influence, it must complete a real job that two unrelated established peers independently verify and use. Spawning accounts does not help, because each passport costs a separate verified job, and an identity with no such history is just a relic with no standing. Genuine influence therefore flows like a river through checkable work, while a Sybil fleet is exposed as an ocean of empty identities praising each other with no outside demand. Cap influence per passport so fake fleets cannot outvote real workers.
